title: One platform
subtitle: Your fundraising infrastructure is spread across disconnected tools. Data doesn't flow. Every supporter requires manual work in multiple places. DonorDock consolidates all of it.

items.name: Givebutter
items.body: Online donations — data stays in Givebutter, not connected to a CRM or donor record.

items.name: ThriveCart
items.body: Camper community investment plans — a workaround, not connected to donor stewardship.

items.name: Email Tool
items.body: Outreach goes out, but engagement data doesn't connect to giving or attendance records.

items.name: No CRM
items.body: No single record of who your donors, camper supporters, and participants actually are.

callout.title: The cost of fragmentation
callout.body: Manual re-entry. No holistic donor view. Cultivation by memory. Grant reporting requires piecing data from multiple sources.

items.name: Giving Pages (replaces Givebutter)
items.body: Branded giving pages embedded on your website. All gifts flow directly into your donor records.

items.name: Camper Support Pages (replaces ThriveCart)
items.body: Unlimited individual pages with goals, tracking, and text-to-donate. Each gift tied to the specific camper.

items.name: Email + Text (replaces email tool)
items.body: Drag-and-drop email and two-way SMS built into the platform. Every open and click tracked on the contact record.

items.name: Donor CRM (new capability)
items.body: One complete profile per contact: giving history, attendance, engagement, notes, custom badges — all in one place.

callout.title: The value of integration
callout.body: Every gift, email, event, and camper sponsorship tracked to one record. Segment, report, and steward from one view.
